description.value: Fable Kitchen is a farm-to-table sit-down restaurant in Kitsilano's West 4th corridor, open since 2012 and built around locally sourced, seasonal ingredients that change with the menu. Head chef Michael Broadbent leads a team known for creative cuisine paired with a notable cocktail and wine program. The restaurant has been featured in the Michelin Guide Vancouver coverage and multiple Best Brunch lists, making it a noteworthy destination on a popular cycling corridor.
